authority_rule: Creator-approved D6 raster mockups are binding visual composition references for the surfaces they depict. Canonical repository content and explicit D6 product decisions remain the only authority for facts, labels, controls, live state, and capabilities.
reference_policy: Do not copy hallucinated mockup content. Do preserve the approved hierarchy, proportions, density, imagery prominence, navigation character, major geometry, spatial relationships, and visual tone. The included SVGs are secondary sanitized annotations and do not replace the approved raster mockups.

visual_acceptance_blocker.reason: The original creator-approved raster mockups are not currently stored in this repository. Visual acceptance must remain blocked until the final approved references are supplied to the implementation/review session or durably added to the repo.
visual_acceptance_blocker.rule: Functional implementation may continue, but no model may declare D7 visual PASS or regenerate final approved baselines from prose/SVGs alone.
